name: opportunity-solution-tree
tagline_zh: 产品探索总是一团乱麻？把目标拆成机会、方案和实验，像 Teresa Torres 那样画一棵树。
tagline_en: Tired of messy discovery? Map outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and experiments in one tree—know exactly what.
desc_en: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree (OST) to structure product discovery — map a desired outcome to opportunities, solutions, and experiments. Based on Teresa Torres' Continuous Discovery Habits. Use when structuring discovery work, mapping opportunities to solutions, or deciding what to build next.
why_zh: 不只是画图，它按持续发现习惯内置了优先级规则，让每个分支都指向可验证的实验。
why_en: Not just a diagram—it encodes Torres' prioritization rules, turning every branch into a testable experiment.
